what: IRWB-004: opening Candela as a project and applying cfg in the page (both still on the main thread), Chromium via Playwright on 127.0.0.1:8772, after the Candela view loaded. Profiles: CDP Profiler, 0.5 ms sampling; inclusive ms per function.
cause of the hashing cost: Sha256.update passed the rest of the text (text.slice(pos)) to TextEncoder.encodeInto for every 64 KiB; Chromium flattened that rest each time. Node uses node:crypto and never ran this path on large texts. Fixed: a window of at most (buffer room)/3 UTF-16 units. The portable path now hashes 18 MB in 330-390 ms in Node.
acceptance: not reached for open and pass: both are one main-thread task (8.6 s and 21.3 s). Rendering is in the worker (19-browser-render.json).
